title: plugin.json — the manifest of a plugin (manifest 2)
description: A plugin of 卫戍协议：盟约 (Stronghold Protocol: Alliance): plugins/<id>/plugin.json beside the files it names. docs/PLUGINS.md §3–§5 (the manifest, permissions, files), §9 (the asset overlay: overlay.schema.json). Accepted here = node tools/plugin.mjs check finds neither a problem nor a warning in the manifest itself; what only the check sees: the folder (the id is its name; the files exist, of the types the class carries, inside the folder), the running game's version against "app", a plugin both required and in conflict or both after and before, a setting's min ≤ max and its default within them, a theme naming a URL, the limits.

id.description: Optional: the folder name is the id (2–32 lower-case letters, digits and -); a different id here is only a warning.

name.description: The display name: a text in sourceLang, or { "zh": "…", "en": "…" }.

description.description: One or two sentences: a text in sourceLang, or { "zh": "…", "en": "…" }.

app.description: The game versions it is made for: ">=0.3.0 <0.4.0", "0.3.x", "^0.3.0" …

class.description: cosmetic: art, models, audio. lang: a language. content: data, DSL. ui: an interface page in a sandboxed frame (P4). script, trusted: code (not loaded by this version).

scope.description: Who switches it on: room (the host, for the room), personal (a player, for themself), server (trusted only).

credits.description: Where the art comes from, who made it.

license.description: An SPDX id (CC-BY-4.0, CC0-1.0, MIT …) or words.

sourceLang.description: The language of plain-text names (default zh).

optional.description: Plugins it loads after when present: { "<id>": "<version range>" }.

conflicts.description: Plugins it cannot be used with: { "<id>": "<version range>" }.

priority.description: Among plugins free to load, the higher first (default 0).

settings.description: Settings the host sets (boolean, integer / number with min and max, enum with options) — no free text.

permissions.description: What it does: assets.override (replaces the installation's art), assets.add (a new entry), theme …

assets.description: The asset overlay (overlay.schema.json), or the path of a .json file holding it.

notices.description: Plain text announcements, including optional translations; see docs/PLUGINS.md §9.2. The runtime also rejects whitespace-only text, duplicate normalized languages and impossible calendar dates. Server catalogue and client view keep at most 100 notices and 48 KiB of serialized notice arrays, newest first, skipping entries that do not fit and continuing.

theme.description: Theme variables: allowlisted colour, time and easing tokens (theme.vars), applied on the player's own page. Each raw value is at most 400 characters before trimming or parsing.

slots.description: ui: the places the page asks for (DESIGN §32.8). One slot per plugin is granted; absent or empty, the plugin loads and the host grants none (a warning).

rules.description: Gameplay rule switches (DESIGN §34.15). Absent means today's rules. Only a content, script or trusted plugin may set any of these.

offers.description: Interaction-window JSON paths (API 2); permission offers. Declarations and card sources are checked by plugin check (PLUGINS §10b).

anyOf.description: API 2 operator files may consume this permission in their trait or kit DSL; plugin check validates the referenced records.
